note: veal, beef and pork, and go easy on the onions like Vinnie

dish.make_ahead: Sauce up to 2 days ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Soak the bread in the milk, then mix with the minces, egg, pecorino, parsley and 1 crushed garlic clove.
Roll into 16 balls and brown in olive oil.
In the same pot gently cook the remaining garlic sliced razor thin and the onion, add the tomatoes and the meatballs, and simmer.
Cook the spaghetti and serve with the sauce and meatballs.
Take the rump steaks out of the fridge 30 minutes early and season well with salt and pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a heavy pan until smoking.
Cook the steaks two at a time, 2 to 3 minutes each side for rare or 4 minutes for medium.
In the last minute add the butter and smashed garlic and spoon them over the steaks.
Rest the steaks for 5 minutes before serving.

note: Chicken thighs and mushrooms baked over rice in thyme cream stock

dish.n: Mum's chicken and mushroom rice bake

steps.text: Brown the chicken and mushrooms.
Spread the rice in a baking dish and add the chicken and mushrooms.
Pour over the hot stock and cream with thyme.
Cover and bake at 180C until golden on top.

note: Seared sirloin with garlic butter, plus a baked potato

steps.text: Bake the potatoes at 200C.
Mash the butter with crushed garlic.
Sear the steaks hard in a hot pan.
Rest the steaks and put a slice of garlic butter on each.
Split the potatoes and load with sour cream and chives.

note: Roast lemon thyme chicken breasts, baby potatoes and buttered green beans

dish.n: Lemon thyme chicken with baby potatoes

steps.text: Rub the chicken with lemon juice, thyme, oil and salt.
Roast the potatoes at 200C for 20 minutes, then add the chicken and roast for another 20 minutes.
Steam the beans and toss everything with butter.

note: Grilled rib eyes and corn on the cob with creamy cabbage slaw

dish.n: Airbase rib eye, corn and slaw

steps.text: Shred the cabbage and carrots and toss with the mayonnaise, vinegar, sugar and salt.
Grill the steaks and corn over high heat.
Rest the steaks and serve with corn and slaw.

note: Beef chuck, carrots and mushrooms braised 3 hours in Worcestershire gravy

steps.text: Dice the beef, onion and carrots and quarter the mushrooms.
Brown the beef in batches in the oil, then soften the vegetables in the same pot.
Stir in the tomato paste, Worcestershire sauce, thyme and stock. Cover and braise at 160C.
Peel and boil the potatoes and mash with the butter and milk.
Serve the stew over the mash with chopped parsley.

note: Shaved rib eye with onion and melted provolone on long rolls

steps.text: Freeze the steak for 30 minutes, then shave it paper thin.
Fry the onions in the oil until soft.
Add the beef and sear fast on high heat.
Lay the provolone over the top to melt and pile into split rolls.

note: Boiled Russian beef and pork dumplings tossed in butter

dish.make_ahead: Freeze uncooked dumplings for up to 1 month

steps.text: Mix the flour, egg and water into a firm dough, knead and rest under a bowl.
Grate the onion and mix with both minces and some salt and pepper.
Roll the dough thin, cut rounds, fill and seal each one.
Boil in salted water until they float and are cooked through.
Toss in the butter and dill and serve with sour cream.

note: Chicken thigh and leek in creamy sauce under a puff pastry lid

steps.text: Cook the diced chicken thigh with the sliced leeks in the butter.
Stir in the flour, the chicken stock and the cream and simmer 10 minutes.
Spoon into a dish, top with puff pastry, brush with egg and bake at 200C for 25 minutes.

note: Grilled rump steak with toasted cassava farofa, tomato vinaigrette and black beans

steps.text: Chop the tomatoes with the onion and vinegar for the vinaigrette.
Toast the cassava flour in the butter until golden and nutty.
Grill the steak over high heat and rest.
Warm the beans. Slice the steak and serve with farofa, beans and the vinaigrette.

note: Braised pork belly, miso broth, ramen noodles and soft boiled eggs

steps.text: Braise the pork belly in soy and water, then slice.
Simmer the pork.
Soft-boil the eggs, cool and halve.
Whisk the miso into hot stock.
Cook the noodles and build the bowls with pork, eggs, nori and spring onion.

note: Beef braised in red wine with bacon and mushrooms

steps.text: Brown the beef and bacon.
Add the mushrooms and cook until golden.
Pour in the red wine.
Simmer gently until tender and glossy.
Boil and mash the potatoes with plenty of butter and serve under the beef.

note: Rare rib of beef, roast potatoes, Yorkshire puddings and red wine jus

dish.n: Manor roast beef and Yorkshire pudding
dish.make_ahead: Salt the beef the night before

steps.text: Salt the beef and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight.
Roast at 120C until 52C inside, then rest.
Peel and chop the potatoes and roast them in some of the oil.
Whisk the eggs, flour and milk and bake in hot oiled tins at 220C until puffed.
Blast the beef at 260C for 10 minutes. Reduce the red wine with the stock for a jus.

note: Beef chili with dried chilies, tomatoes and kidney beans, skillet cornbread

dish.make_ahead: Better the next day, keep chilled

steps.text: Soak the dried chillies in hot water and blitz.
Brown the beef in batches.
Add the chillies, cumin, garlic, tomatoes and kidney beans.
Braise until the beef is tender.
Bake the cornbread in a skillet and serve with the chilli.

note: Short ribs rubbed with paprika, garlic and brown sugar, cooked five hours

steps.text: Rub the ribs with paprika, garlic, sugar and salt.
Cook uncovered at 140C until a dark crust forms and the meat is tender.
Grill the corn, brush with butter, and toss the cabbage with mayonnaise for a slaw.

note: Lemon oregano lamb skewers with cucumber garlic yogurt

dish.make_ahead: Lamb can marinate up to 1 day

ingredients.item: garlic cloves, 3 for the marinade and 1 for the sauce

steps.text: Marinate the lamb in the lemon juice, garlic, oregano and oil.
Leave to marinate for 2 hours.
Thread onto skewers and grill hot.
Mix the yoghurt with the grated cucumber and garlic.
Serve in warm pita with tomato and red onion.

note: Shredded chicken and egg noodles in thick broth, over mashed potato

dish.n: Amish chicken and noodles over mash

steps.text: Simmer the chicken thighs in the chicken stock with the diced onion, the diced carrots and the celery sticks for 35 minutes.
Lift out the chicken, shred it and return it to the pot.
Add the wide egg noodles and simmer 8 minutes until the broth thickens.
Season well with salt and plenty of white pepper.
Meanwhile boil the peeled potatoes for 20 minutes and mash with the butter and the milk.
Ladle the chicken and noodles over the mash and scatter with chopped parsley.

note: Pepperoni, garlic mushroom and mozzarella pizza with chilli oil

steps.text: Divide the dough in two and stretch each into a round on oiled trays. Spread with pizza sauce.
Fry the mushrooms with the garlic in a little oil.
Top the bases with mozzarella, pepperoni and mushrooms.
Bake at 240C until blistered.
Scatter with oregano and drizzle with chilli oil.

note: Sliced rump steak, caramelized onions, provolone and horseradish mayo on a toasted roll

steps.text: Cook the sliced onions slowly in the butter until golden.
Sear the steaks and rest.
Mix the mayonnaise and horseradish and toast the rolls.
Slice the steak and pile into rolls with onions and provolone.

note: Thick beef patties on white bread with soft fried onions and tomato sauce

steps.text: Season the mince and shape into thick patties
Fry the onions in oil until soft and sweet
Cook the patties over hot coals or in a smoking pan until cooked through, turning once
Serve between thick slices of white bread with the onions and tomato sauce

note: Lamb mince with carrots and peas under mash

steps.text: Dice the onion, grate the carrots and peel the potatoes.
Brown the mince with onion and carrot, add peas and a little water and simmer until thick.
Boil and mash the potatoes with butter.
Spread the mince in a dish and top with mash.
Bake at 200C until golden.

note: Thick chuck cheeseburger with iceberg, tomato, onion and pickles

steps.text: Shape the mince into four thick patties. Prep the lettuce, tomato, onion and pickles.
Season just before cooking and griddle on a hot surface to medium.
Lay cheddar on top and cover with a lid until melted.
Toast the buns and build the burgers with all the toppings.

note: Creamy arborio risotto stirred through with pea and spinach puree

steps.text: Heat the stock, grate the parmesan and blitz the peas and spinach with a splash of stock until smooth.
Stir the rice in some of the butter, then add the hot stock a ladle at a time.
Stir through the green puree, the rest of the butter and the parmesan until bright green.

note: Snapper poached in coconut milk with lemongrass, red chilli and lime

steps.text: Bruise the lemongrass and slice the chilli.
Simmer the lemongrass and chilli in the coconut milk.
Add the fish and poach gently.
Steam the rice.
Squeeze in lime juice and serve over the rice with fresh herbs.

note: Creamy bacon and potato clam chowder in hollowed toasted cob loaves

dish.n: Fatso's clam chowder in bread bowls

steps.text: Soak and scrub the clams. Dice the bacon, onion, celery and potatoes.
Steam the clams open in a covered pot and strain the liquid.
Render the bacon, add the onion and celery and cook until soft.
Add the potatoes, clam liquid and milk and simmer.
Stir in the cream and clams. Hollow out and toast the cob loaves and ladle the chowder in.

note: Buttermilk pancakes with crisp bacon and soft scrambled eggs

steps.text: Whisk the flour, baking powder, 2 of the eggs and the buttermilk into a batter.
Cook the pancakes in a buttered pan and keep warm.
Fry the bacon until crisp.
Scramble the remaining eggs softly.
Slice the strawberries.
Pile everything onto big plates with the maple syrup on the side.

film: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets (2002)
note: Lamb and carrot pie in tomato Worcestershire gravy under buttery mash

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheat to serve

steps.text: Brown the lamb mince in a large pan.
Add the onion, carrots, tomato paste and Worcestershire sauce and simmer.
Boil the potatoes until tender and mash with the butter and milk.
Spread the mince in a dish, top with mash and bake at 200C until golden.

note: Chili lime grilled chicken thighs with rice and warm beans

dish.n: Isla Nublar chilli lime chicken and beans
dish.make_ahead: Marinate up to 1 day, grill fresh

ingredients.item: limes, 2 for the marinade and 1 for the salsa

steps.text: Marinate the chicken in lime juice, garlic, chilli, oil and salt for an hour.
Grill over high heat until charred and cooked through. Cook the rice at the same time.
Warm the beans with the cumin and paprika.
Mix the tomatoes, onion, coriander and a squeeze of lime for the salsa. Serve the chicken over rice and beans with the salsa.

note: Herb butter roast turkey breast with cornbread stuffing

steps.text: Mash some butter with sage and push it under the skin of the turkey.
Roast at 180C.
Fry the onion and celery, crumble in the cornbread and mix with sage, egg and some stock. Bake in a dish for the last part of the roasting.
Boil the potatoes and mash with butter and milk.
Simmer the cranberry sauce with the orange zest.
Rest the turkey and make gravy from the juices with the flour and remaining stock.

note: the old man's favourite

dish.make_ahead: Assemble up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled; add 10 minutes to the bake

steps.text: Remove the sausages from their casings and brown in the oil, breaking up the meat.
Add the onion for 5 minutes, then the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the passata, water and oregano and simmer gently, stirring.
Boil the ziti for 2 minutes less than the packet time and drain. Mix the ricotta with the seasoning.
Layer pasta, sugo, ricotta and mozzarella in an ovenproof dish.
Bake at 200C for 25 minutes until blistered and rest for 10 minutes.

note: Beef and pork meatballs in tomato sauce on rolls under melted mozzarella

steps.text: Mix the minces with the salt and roll into balls.
Bake at 200C until browned.
Simmer the meatballs in the crushed tomatoes.
Pile into split rolls, cover with mozzarella and grill until bubbly. Finish with basil.

note: Wok fried pork, cabbage and carrot with udon in oyster and soy sauce

steps.text: Slice the pork thin and toss with some of the soy sauce.
Prep the cabbage and carrot.
Stir-fry the pork in a smoking wok with the oil.
Add the cabbage and carrot and stir-fry briefly.
Add the udon, oyster sauce, remaining soy sauce and wine and toss until glossy.
Finish with spring onion.

note: Brined turkey breast rolled with sage butter, stuffing, roast potatoes, gravy

steps.text: Brine the turkey overnight in salted water in the fridge.
Mix the butter with chopped sage, spread over the turkey and roll. Peel and chop the potatoes.
Roast the turkey at 170C until 70C inside, with the potatoes in the tray for the last hour.
Rest the turkey for 20 minutes. Bake the stuffing alongside as the packet says.
Make gravy with the pan juices and stock.

note: Pork sausages on buttery mash with onion gravy

steps.text: Brown the pork sausages slowly in a pan for 15 minutes.
Boil the potatoes and mash with the butter and the milk.
Fry the sliced onions in the sausage pan until soft, stir in the flour and the beef stock and simmer until thick.
Serve the sausages on mash with gravy.

note: Crisp-skinned barramundi, crushed baby potatoes, lemon caper butter

steps.text: Boil the potatoes until tender and crush lightly.
Pan fry the barramundi skin side down until crisp, then flip briefly.
Add butter, lemon juice and capers to the pan and spoon over the fish.
Serve with the potatoes and lemon wedges.

note: Beef chuck stewed with carrots, onion and potatoes

steps.text: Dice the onion, carrots and potatoes.
Brown the beef in batches in oil.
Add the vegetables and stock and simmer until thick and tender.
Ladle into bowls and serve with crusty bread.

note: Cumin, coriander and cinnamon lamb roasted until it pulls apart

steps.text: Rub the lamb shoulder with the cumin, the coriander, the cinnamon, chilli and salt.
Roast covered at 160C for 3.5 hours until it pulls apart.
Steep a pinch of saffron in hot water and cook the basmati rice with it until golden and fluffy.

note: pancakes, eggs, bacon, toast and pie, everything at once

steps.text: Mix the flour, baking powder, sugar, one egg and buttermilk into a batter and rest
Render the bacon slowly over medium heat until crisp and keep warm
Cook small pancakes in half the butter until bubbles set and both sides are golden
Fry four eggs in the bacon pan until the whites are set
Toast the bread and butter with the remaining butter
Warm small slices of pie at 180C
Bring everything to the table at once, with maple syrup for the pancakes

note: Pan seared sirloin in peppercorn brandy cream, with thin cut fries

dish.make_ahead: Salt the steaks the night before

steps.text: Dry-brine the steaks overnight.
Cut the potatoes thin and fry at 140C, drain, then fry at 185C until crisp.
Sear the steaks hard in cast iron, pull at 54C and rest.
Crush the peppercorns in the pan, flame the brandy, add the cream and reduce until it coats a spoon.
Finish with the butter and serve.

note: Beef chuck slow simmered with chipotle, cumin and kidney beans

steps.text: Chop the chipotles and drain the beans.
Brown the beef in batches in oil.
Add the tomatoes, cumin, chipotles and water to cover and simmer.
Add the beans for the last stretch of cooking.
Serve with sour cream.

note: they finally make it home for Thanksgiving

dish.make_ahead: Turkey brines the day before. Cooked turkey keeps 2 days chilled

steps.text: Dissolve the salt in the water, submerge the turkey and refrigerate for 6 hours
Drain, pat dry and roast at 170C until the centre reaches 70C for 2 minutes
Make the stuffing mix with the packet water amount, spread in a small dish and bake beside the turkey, then cut into squares
Rest the turkey and slice
Melt the butter, stir in the flour for a minute, whisk in the stock and simmer for gravy
Fill the buns with turkey, cranberry sauce, stuffing squares and a spoonful of gravy

note: Juniper rubbed venison backstrap in whisky redcurrant sauce, with mash

steps.text: Roast the potatoes with the oil at 200C until golden and crisp.
Boil the swede until soft, drain and mash with the butter.
Rub the venison with juniper, thyme and pepper. Sear in a hot pan until browned all over, then rest.
Add the whisky, redcurrant jelly and stock to the pan and reduce to a glossy sauce.
Slice the venison and serve with the mash, potatoes and sauce.

note: Pan-seared salmon in foaming caper butter with crushed baby potatoes

steps.text: Boil the potatoes until tender, drain and crush with oil and salt.
Season the salmon and cook skin side down in a hot oiled pan, then flip.
Wipe the pan, melt the butter until it foams brown, then add the capers, lemon juice and parsley.
Toss the rocket with parmesan, oil and lemon.
Plate the salmon on the potatoes and spoon over the butter.

note: Creamy chicken and vegetable pie under golden puff pastry

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, reheat to serve

steps.text: Brown the chicken in the oil.
Add the onion, carrots and celery and soften.
Stir in the flour, cream, thyme and peas and simmer until thick.
Pour into a pie dish, top with pastry and egg wash.
Bake at 200C until puffed and golden.

note: Beef chuck braised with tomatoes, dried chilies and kidney beans

dish.n: Rainy night beef and bean stew
dish.make_ahead: Better the next day, keep chilled

steps.text: Brown the beef in batches.
Add the sliced onion, crushed garlic and crumbled chillies.
Pour in the tomatoes and water to cover.
Braise at 160C.
Add the kidney beans for the last 30 minutes.

note: Spicy stew of pork belly and kimchi with gochugaru, simmered until rich

steps.text: Slice the pork and chop the kimchi.
Fry the pork until browned, then add the kimchi, garlic and gochugaru.
Pour in the water and simmer.
Add sliced tofu and spring onion and simmer for the last few minutes. Serve with rice.

note: Seared eye fillet, creamy potato gratin and red wine pan sauce

steps.text: Slice the potatoes thinly.
Layer with cream in a dish and bake at 180C until tender.
Sear the steaks hard in butter.
Roast at 200C until the centre reaches 54C, then rest.
Deglaze the pan with red wine and stock and reduce until glossy.
Char the asparagus and serve with the steak and sauce.

note: Al Powell lives on snack cakes, you don't have to

dish.make_ahead: Beef up to 1 day ahead, slice before serving

steps.text: Rub the beef with Dijon, pepper and salt.
Roast at 200C until 52C inside.
Rest, then shave thin.
Stir the horseradish into the sour cream.
Split the rolls, spread with horseradish cream and fill with beef, rocket and pickled onions.

note: he knows exactly how a scene should go

dish.make_ahead: Make the sauce while the steak rests; fry the chips twice

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into thin frites and fry at 140C for 5 minutes, then rest.
Season the steaks and sear hard for 3 minutes a side, then rest.
Sweat the shallots in the pan fat, add the wine and reduce by two thirds, then whisk in the butter.
Fry the frites again at 185C until crisp.
Slice the steak and spoon the sauce over.

note: Chicken, leek and corn in a cream sauce under a shortcrust lid

dish.n: Cooper Station chicken and corn pie

steps.text: Poach the chicken and shred.
Soften the leek in butter.
Stir in the flour, then the stock and cream.
Add the chicken, corn and thyme.
Tip into a dish and top with the pastry.
Bake at 200C.

note: Slow braised beef pie with a puff pastry lid, tomato sauce on top

dish.n: Last of the V8s highway meat pie

steps.text: Brown the beef in batches
Add the stock and Worcestershire and braise
Thicken with flour and cool
Line four pie tins with shortcrust and fill
Top with puff and bake at 200C
Add sauce on top

note: Pork shoulder, potato and charred green chilli stew

steps.text: Brown the diced pork shoulder, then soften the onion and the garlic cloves.
Char the large green chillies, peel, chop and add with the diced potatoes and the chicken stock.
Simmer 90 minutes until the pork is tender.
Serve with the warm flour tortillas.

note: Frank pays for his own lunch, unlike the rest of the precinct

dish.make_ahead: Dressing and slaw up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Steam the pastrami until glossy.
Mix the mayonnaise, tomato sauce, horseradish and pickle for Russian dressing.
Toss the coleslaw mix with half the dressing.
Fill the rolls with pastrami, Swiss cheese, slaw and the rest of the dressing.

note: Brisket braised in red wine, stock and tomato paste, roast carrots

steps.text: Brown the brisket and soften the onions.
Add the wine, stock and tomato paste.
Braise covered at 160C.
Add the carrots and roast for the last 40 minutes.
Slice the meat across the grain.

note: Seared rump steaks topped with garlic butter, twice-fried chips on the side

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into chips. Mash the butter with the garlic.
Fry the chips at 140C until soft and pale.
Fry again at 185C until crisp.
Season the steaks and sear hard, then rest.
Top each with a slice of garlic butter. Save the trimmings for the dog.

note: Beef and pork meatballs in tomato sauce over spaghetti, extra parmesan

steps.text: Mix the mince with some of the parmesan and the parsley. Roll into balls.
Brown the meatballs in oil.
Simmer the meatballs in the tomatoes for 40 minutes.
Cook the spaghetti, toss with the sauce and more parmesan, and save a plate for the toys.

note: Shredded roast duck legs, steamed pancakes, cucumber, spring onion, hoisin

steps.text: Salt the duck legs and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight.
Roast at 180C until the skin is crisp, then shred the meat.
Cut the cucumber and spring onions into matchsticks.
Steam the pancakes.
Serve the duck with the pancakes, vegetables and hoisin for rolling at the table.

note: Beef cheeseburgers with bacon, crinkle chips and onion rings

steps.text: Bake the chips and onion rings at 220C until crisp.
Grill the bacon.
Roll the mince into balls, smash flat in a very hot oiled pan, season and cook, then flip and top with cheese.
Toast the buns.
Set out the toppings and sauces and let everyone build their own.
Score the skin of the barramundi fillets, pat very dry and brush with the oil.
Grill skin down over high heat for about 4 minutes until crisp, then flip for 1 minute.
Melt the butter with the garlic and lemon myrtle, spoon over the fish and serve with the lemons cut into wedges.

note: Beef topside, Yorkshire puddings baked in muffin tins, roast potatoes

steps.text: Season the beef. Whisk the flour, eggs and milk into a batter and rest it.
Roast the beef at 200C to medium.
Peel and chop the potatoes and put them in alongside.
Rest the beef. Heat oiled muffin tins.
Pour in the batter and bake.
Make gravy from the pan juices and stock.

note: Lamb shoulder, carrot, parsnip and pearl barley in beef stock

steps.text: Brown the diced lamb shoulder, then add the onion, the carrots and the parsnips in chunks, the pearl barley, thyme and the beef stock.
Cover and simmer 2 hours until the lamb is tender and the barley is plump.
Serve in big bowls with bread.

note: Capsicums stuffed with beef and rice, baked in tomato, garlic yoghurt

ingredients.item: garlic cloves (2 for the filling, 1 for the yoghurt)

steps.text: Fry the onion and two of the garlic cloves, add the mince and brown.
Stir in the rice, both paprikas, salt and a little water and cook briefly.
Cut the tops off the capsicums, remove the seeds and fill.
Stand in a dish, pour around the passata mixed with water and bake covered at 180C.
Mix the yoghurt with the remaining crushed garlic. Serve with crusty bread.

note: Samoan chop suey: glass noodles, chicken, garlic, ginger and soy

steps.text: Soak the glass noodles in hot water and drain.
Slice the chicken, carrots and onion. Crush the garlic and chop the ginger.
Fry the chicken with the garlic and ginger until browned, then add the carrots and onion.
Add the noodles, soy sauce and water and toss until the noodles soak it all up.

note: Slow-cooked chuck roast with carrots, potatoes and horseradish sour cream

steps.text: Season the chuck roast and quarter the onions, peel the carrots and halve the potatoes.
Brown the roast all over in oil in a heavy pot.
Add the onions, garlic, tomato paste, stock, Worcestershire, thyme and bay leaves.
Cover and cook at 160C.
Add the carrots and potatoes.
Cook for another hour.
Thicken the juices with cornflour.
Mix the sour cream with horseradish cream.

note: Buttermilk fried chicken with mashed potatoes and gravy

dish.make_ahead: Soak the chicken the day before

steps.text: Soak the chicken overnight in the buttermilk and salt.
Dredge in seasoned flour.
Fry at 165C in batches until 74C inside.
Boil the potatoes and mash with the butter and milk.
Make gravy from a little of the frying fat, flour and the stock.

note: Chicken thighs simmered in coconut milk, tomato and garam masala

steps.text: Dice the chicken and grate the ginger and garlic.
Soften the ginger and garlic in the oil.
Add the garam masala and fry for a minute.
Add the chicken, tomatoes and coconut milk and simmer until the chicken is cooked through.
Cook the basmati rice according to the packet.
Warm the naan and serve with the curry and rice.

note: Garlic rosemary lamb shoulder roasted 5 hours until it pulls apart, mint yogurt

steps.text: Cut slits in the lamb and push in the garlic, rosemary and lemon.
Roast covered at 150C until the lamb pulls apart.
Roast the potatoes in oil alongside for the last hour.
Mix the yoghurt with the mint.
Rest the lamb and pull apart to serve.

note: Pork chops simmered in apple cider with apple, onion and sage, over mash

steps.text: Brown the chops in oil and set aside
Soften the onion and apples with sage
Pour in the cider, return the chops and simmer until the sauce reduces
Boil the potatoes and mash with butter
